player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Jokali 0 akómaka {choice0}; Jokali 1 akómaka {choice1}. Match -> Jokali 0 azóngaka
message.round_mismatch: Jokali 0 akómaka {choice0}; Jokali 1 akómaka {choice1}. Mismatch -> Jokali 1 azóngaka.

outcome.p1_wins: Mosani ya liboso alongaki masano mingi.
outcome.draw: Na mobimba, lisano yango ezali na molɔngɔ te.
